domain_hypothesis.reasoning: The dataset contains customer invoices with fields like InvoiceId, CustomerId, InvoiceDate, billing address components (BillingAddress, BillingCity, BillingState, BillingCountry, BillingPostalCode), and a transaction Total. This is characteristic of a retail or digital commerce transactional store database.

kpi_specs.name: Total Revenue
kpi_specs.description: Calculates the sum of all invoice totals to measure the overall sales volume of the business.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT SUM(Total) AS Total FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: Total revenue is the primary high-level metric for sales performance, best represented as a single summary number.

kpi_specs.name: Monthly Revenue Trend
kpi_specs.description: Tracks the monthly aggregated billing total over time to observe growth and seasonal patterns.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) AS InvoiceDate, SUM(Total) AS Total FROM data GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', InvoiceDate) ORDER BY InvoiceDate ASC
kpi_specs.reasoning: A monthly aggregation grouped chronologically allows stakeholders to see sales trends over time, which fits a line chart.

kpi_specs.name: Revenue by Billing Country
kpi_specs.description: Aggregates sales revenue by the customer billing country to find the top-performing geographic markets.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT BillingCountry, SUM(Total) AS Total FROM data GROUP BY BillingCountry ORDER BY Total DESC
kpi_specs.reasoning: Comparing sales volume across categorical country groups is most effectively displayed on a descending bar chart.

kpi_specs.name: Top Customers by Total Spend
kpi_specs.description: Lists the highest-spending customers, along with their order counts and total transaction values.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT CustomerId, COUNT(InvoiceId) AS InvoiceId, SUM(Total) AS Total FROM data GROUP BY CustomerId ORDER BY Total DESC LIMIT 10
kpi_specs.reasoning: A table is appropriate here to present a ranked list of top customers with multiple metrics (order frequency and spend).

kpi_specs.name: Average Order Value (AOV)
kpi_specs.description: Calculates the average transaction value per invoice to monitor buyer basket sizes.
kpi_specs.sql_query: SELECT AVG(Total) AS Total FROM data
kpi_specs.reasoning: Average Order Value is a vital retail KPI that measures purchasing behavior, best summarized in a single card visual.
